payload.name: Infer advice from demonstrated activities and hobbies
payload.description: When a question asks what advice a person or people would give about a major life transition, challenge, or personal growth, search for their own stress-relieving activities and hobbies as evidence in addition to explicit advice memories.
content: If a question asks what advice someone would give about a major life transition or challenge and explicit advice searches return limited results, run additional hybrid searches using concrete activity/hobby terms the person has mentioned (e.g., hiking, painting, road trips) combined with their names.
Treat memories of the person's own hobbies, travels, and stress-relieving activities as evidence of advice they would give, even if the memory does not contain the words 'advice' or 'recommend'.
Stop once the retrieved activities cover the core claims of the answer or after two to three diverse activity searches per subject; do not keep expanding to unrelated topics.

solves: When a question asks what advice someone would give about a major life transition or personal growth, the agent searches only for explicit advice/recommendation memories and misses relevant evidence stored as the person's own hobbies and stress-relieving activities. This skill ensures those demonstrated behaviors are retrieved and used as evidence.
